packs.package_dir_note: DGN-803 LS-5 e2: kit-class row. The lifekit pack lives in its OWN repo (sibling checkout convention: <agent-repo-parent>/dogany-lifekit); package_dir resolves relative to this catalog file. pack_version is NOT duplicated here -- the pack repo's pack-manifest.json is authoritative (pack_install.sh falls back to it). status flipped scaffold->published at the first pack publish signoff (LS-6, DGN-783, pack/lifekit/v1.1.0). kind='kit' keeps this row out of the public installer domain-pack menu (install.sh MINOR-2 kit filter): kits are activated post-mint via pack_install.sh, never minted as a domain agent. DGN-1143 M3 / dec-145: the pack's INSTALL IDENTITY was renamed lifekit -> kit_life (pack repo commit 5fdb24e) and this row was the last holdout -- catalog id + provides_kit now mirror pack-manifest.json (id=kit_life, provides_kit=kit_life) as the D-D counter-signature requires. NO old-id alias: the catalog id is a lookup key joined by EXACT match in five places (compat-lint D-D, pack_coords.pack_catalog_row, skill_collision_check --restrict, update.sh fw-reqfw-guard backfill, update_seed.sh registry seeding) and a second accepted spelling would re-introduce the two-rules-for-one-fact shape pack_coords.sh (DGN-1079) exists to remove. Measured before the rename: DOGANY_PACK_ID=lifekit was already unreachable (install.sh catalog_entries filters kind=='kit' in BOTH scopes, install.sh:2050-2053, so scope=all never yields this row), and every instance-side record had already moved: the mounted instances carry config/packs/kit_life.requires_framework + DOGANY_PACKS=kit_life@<ver>, the shared pack-sources registry keys on kit_life.repo=, and the health-trainer manifest declares requires_kit.kit=kit_life. NAME/repo are deliberately NOT renamed: product name (Lifekit / 라이프킷), repo dogany-lifekit and the dogany-lifekit-setup skill name are protected surfaces. Lockstep is mechanized by scripts/tests/test-catalog-manifest-lockstep.sh.
